relationships.subject: Angiotensin-converting enzyme
relationships.evidence_quote: These results showed that direct inhibition of ACE in cultured astrocytes with captopril and enalapril prevents the degradation of SP and BK.

relationships.subject: Captopril
relationships.evidence_quote: BK immunoreactivity was increased after captopril (Fig. 2A; 1 or 10 mg/mL, n = 7) or enalapril (Fig. 2B; 1 or 10 mg/mL, n = 7) treatment in GFAP-positive cultured astrocytes

relationships.subject: Captopril
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, the expression of the PKCβI isoform was statistically increased by the treatment with captopril (Fig. 3C; p < 0.001 vs. vehicle control group).

relationships.subject: B1 Receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with the BK B1 receptor antagonist, R 715 (3 µg/mL, n = 5), or the BK B2 receptor antagonist, HOE 140 (3 µg/mL, n = 5) inhibited the captopril-induced increased expression of PKCβI isoform

relationships.subject: B2 Receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with the BK B1 receptor antagonist, R 715 (3 µg/mL, n = 5), or the BK B2 receptor antagonist, HOE 140 (3 µg/mL, n = 5) inhibited the captopril-induced increased expression of PKCβI isoform

relationships.subject: Captopril
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunocytochemistry revealed that SP immunoreactivity was increased after captopril (Fig. 1A; 1 or 10 mg/mL, n = 7)

key_findings: ACE inhibition with captopril or enalapril increased SP and BK immunoreactivity in cultured mouse astrocytes, reversed by exogenous ACE.
Captopril-induced PKCβI expression was blocked by NK-1, BK B1 and B2 receptor antagonists.
